DIAGNOSIS READY: Glossopharyngeal Neuralgia

The patient's history of chronic ear infections and recent tympanoplasty, combined with shooting pain triggered by chewing and discomfort from earrings, strongly suggests irritation of the glossopharyngeal nerve. Given the post-surgical context and the specific nature of the pain, I suspect nerve entrapment or inflammation. Have you noticed any numbness or tingling in the throat or base of the tongue?
